mathematics.assertion_tested: Compute minimum color deficits by weighted block covers on nine hosts; independently check every block table, all cost states, and coloring witnesses; compare eight maxima with saved partition searches; visit every L5 partition in deficit bands 0..3 and classify all 15 extremizers.
mathematics.conventions: Arbitrary edge colorings; targets are perfect matchings. A block costs size minus one and covers targets meeting it at least twice. Overlapping covering blocks are merged. Fixed edges and color renaming for partitions; graph symmetry quotient separate.
non_claims: Not a full Bell-number enumeration on L5
General ladder formula is established by a separate written proof
